rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A self-hostable skills registry for AI agents that uses semantic search to surface relevant procedures with three-tier progressive disclosure — summary, full instructions, then supplementary resources. Ships with 30 bundled skills covering development, AI/LLM platforms, cloud infrastructure, and web frameworks. Includes prompt-injection security scanning, rate limiting, and deploys as a Cloudflare Python Worker or runs locally via FastMCP.
